name: scene-chiro
title: Chiro
description: A Goan laterite compound wall up close through a year: the pits in each cut block grow as a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, the monsoon darkens the stone from the top, moss creeps out of the joints and the sun bleaches it back. Quiet is the monsoon-green still; warm an easier year; playful takes a hand (pointer, or arrow keys and Enter) that leaves a damp print, and a brush that rubs red dust loose.

budget.reason: The plate's simulation, colouring pass and pencil work, ported line for line.
